blocks.title: Run a real penetration test from the conversation
blocks.description: Strix dispatches a team of security agents that probe your code, APIs and running apps the way an attacker would, then hands back exploitable findings with proof and fixes.

showcase.user_prompt: Check our staging API for auth bypass.
showcase.assistant_reply: Found one critical IDOR and filed the fix.

items.title: Attacker's workflow
items.description: Recon, exploitation and reporting run as separate specialised agents, so each stage is judged by the agent that owns it.

items.title: Evidence, not guesses
items.description: Every finding carries the request, payload or code path that proved it, plus counter-evidence and a confidence rating.

items.title: Live console
items.description: Watch each agent's tool calls as they happen, then read findings sorted by severity without leaving the app.

items.title: Runs stay on disk
items.description: Each scan writes a normal Strix run directory, so reports, SARIF and raw logs stay usable outside this plugin.

items.title: Prepare the machine once
items.description: Strix needs Docker for its sandbox and its own model credential. The console lists exactly what is missing, and where to set it.

items.title: Describe the targets
items.description: Open Strix scans from the tab menu, or click Strix scan to open it with the skill command ready in the composer.

items.title: Read the findings
items.description: Severity, CVSS, proof of concept and remediation per finding; the Markdown report and SARIF file are in the run folder.

blocks.content: Only scan systems you are authorised to test. Strix sends real attack traffic to the targets you give it.
